title: Ex 28: Boolean Practice
checklist: 改几个数字/字符串再跑
body:
# Ex 28 · Boolean Practice

更多布尔表达式练习：先猜结果，再看程序输出。

## 目标
- 对一列表达式做「心算 vs 实算」
- 习惯用括号让优先级清晰

## 自检
- [ ] 至少猜对一半再对答案
- [ ] 改写其中两行加括号

starterFiles.ex28.py:
exprs = [
    "True and True",
    "False and True",
    "1 == 1 and 2 == 1",
    '"test" == "test"',
    "1 == 1 or 2 != 1",
    "True and 1 == 1",
    "False and 0 != 0",
    "True or 1 == 1",
    '"test" == "testing"',
    "1 != 0 and 2 == 1",
    '"test" != "testing"',
    '"test" == 1',
    "not (True and False)",
    "not (1 == 1 and 0 != 1)",
    "not (10 == 1 or 1000 == 1000)",
]

for e in exprs:
    print(f"{e:40} => {eval(e)}")
